title: 文件锁与原子替换：同 JVM 重入锁为何失败
expected_output:
exclusive lock acquired    : true
lock range [pos,end)      : [0, 9223372036854775807)
  (whole-file lock reports size()=Long.MAX_VALUE, not the file length 10)
2nd lock in SAME JVM -> exception : true
  (same JVM overlap throws OverlappingFileLockException, while another PROCESS would make tryLock() return null)
after release, content      : XY23456789
atomic move succeeded      : true
final content              : REPLACED
ATOMIC_MOVE is only guaranteed within one filesystem
